known_limitations: FUNDING LEGS NOT_RUN_BLOCKED (fail-closed, never inferred): the frozen funding-rate series bytes (NG2 data_raw/cng2_funding/funding_history.json sha256 38ad6faf..., untracked) are absent from all accessible storage and this lane's budget forbids network pulls; consequently the 2 funding-level inventory shapes (v17_fundjump_funding_level, cng2_funding_level_pull), the X2 funding half of the dead-form envelope, and the F1 financing-adjusted book are NOT_RUN_BLOCKED. No proposal is certified SURVIVE from this lane; both proposals are KILL on measured vetoes regardless, so the overall verdict VETO_ALL is not affected by the blocked legs.

A4 first-decidable discrepancy disclosed: the proposal pins 'first decidable panel day = index 70 = 2025-10-31' but its own formula admits index 69 (2025-10-30); the pinned date governs (removes at most 1 decision day). A formula-only reading changes no verdict (all kills clear by >= 0.06).

Same-bet shadow rendering is a declared daily adaptation of the hourly-invented V17/V16 inventory shapes (day shapes evaluated at decision date and held; hour shapes compounded over held hours; OI state sampled at entry), recorded in the artifact method block before measurement.

A4 variant arms V1_NEW_FLOAT_NET / V2_CCTP_NETTED were NOT measured: they are sensitivity arms, not the anchor, and their per-address re-netting is not derivable from the frozen day rows (would need chunk-level re-aggregation) — out of light-compute scope, recorded, not a veto.

X5 identifiability margins are tight for both anchors (delayed+1d rho 0.911/0.913 vs bar 0.98): the 7-day overlapping sum (A4) and episode clustering (A5) make the signal highly persistent; nulls are VALID but only just, margins recorded explicitly (Q-11).
A5 population: fold1 carries 2 traded episodes < floor 4 (11 episodes vs declared 12-18 RT/yr band) — an independent population kill on top of the measured vetoes.
